title: L-Ergothioneine
abstract:
# L-Ergothioneine  
Cognitive Health, Healthy Aging, Antioxidant, Cardiovascular Health, Cellular Health  
Ergothioneine is a naturally occurring amino acid and powerful antioxidant. Often referred to as the “longevity vitamin,” ergothioneine plays a vital role in protecting cells from oxidative stress, supporting metabolic health, cognitive function, immune balance, and healthy aging.  
This unique compound supports mitochondrial function and energy production, helping to maintain cellular vitality and resilience throughout the body. Research suggests ergothioneine contributes to DNA repair, healthy inflammatory response, and long-term cognitive wellness.  
Unlike many antioxidants, ergothioneine is actively transported into cells through a specialized transporter (OCTN1), allowing it to reach and protect tissues that are most vulnerable to oxidative damage.  
This high-quality L-ergothioneine is produced through fermentation processes, yielding a pure and sustainable source of the bioactive L-isomer for maximum potency and bioavailability.
##### **Mechanism of Action**  
Specific Transport Mechanism: Ergothioneine is taken up by cells via a specific transporter protein known as the ergothioneine transporter (ETT), also referred to as organic cation transporter novel, type 1 (OCTN1). This transporter is highly expressed in certain tissues, including the liver, kidneys, brain, and immune cells. The presence of this specific transporter suggests that ergothioneine is selectively accumulated in tissues where it is most needed for protection against oxidative stress and other harmful processes.  
While in those selected tissues, ergothioneine acts as a direct antioxidant by scavenging reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species (RNS), such as superoxide radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and peroxynitrite. By neutralizing these free radicals, it helps protect cellular components (e.g., DNA, proteins, lipids) from oxidative damage.
##### **Regulatory**  
Ergothioneine toxicity has been extensively studied and reported in the toxicity literature. Ergothioneine is tested safe at supplement dosages. Ergothioneine (made by fermentation) is FDA GRAS and is a novel food in the EU.
